title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Shares Bought by Harwood Advisory Group LLC

text:
Harwood Advisory Group LLC grew its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 6.7% in the second the company in its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The fund owned 11,151 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 699 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises 1.3% of Harwood Advisory Group LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 19th largest position. Harwood Advisory Group LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $2,066,000 SEC filing.
